info.title: Paysafe Customer Vault API
info.description: Securely store customer profiles, cards, bank accounts and addresses so that repeat and recurring payments never touch raw instrument data in your systems.

tags.name: Single-use tokens
tags.description: Exchange a single-use token for a permanent vault token.

post.description: Creates a new profile. Supply a unique `merchantRefNum` so the request can be safely retried.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of profiles, most recent first.
Retrieves a single profile by its Paysafe id.

put.description: Updates a mutable field on an existing profile.

post.description: Creates a new address. Supply a unique `merchantRefNum` so the request can be safely retried.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of profiles/{profileId}/addresses, most recent first.
Retrieves a single address by its Paysafe id.

put.description: Updates a mutable field on an existing address.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of profiles/{profileId}/cards, most recent first.

put.description: Updates a mutable field on an existing vaultcard.

post.description: Runs a zero-dollar verification against the stored card.

post.description: Creates a token that can be used exactly once, within 15 minutes, to create a permanent vault entry.

get.description: Retrieves the status of a single-use token.

state.description: ISO 3166-2 subdivision code for US and CA addresses.

cardNum.description: Full card number. Only accepted server-side at SAQ D; prefer a payment handle.

singleUseToken.description: Token from Paysafe JS. Exchanged for a permanent card token.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code. Branch on this, not on `message`.

message.example: Either you submitted a request that is missing a mandatory field or the value of a field does not match the format expected.

BadRequest.description: Bad request — a field is missing or malformed.

Offset.name: offset
Offset.description: Zero-based index of the first record to return.
